# MC-19: one-click button in the operator's own browser fills step 1 from the open Shopee product page

- Source: `CEO-D-1318` (the CEO's own decision, 2026-10-30); local://research/ceo-decision-record.md#ceo-d-1318
- Issue type: Feature   Priority: Highest
- Labels: affiliate, shopee-video, pilot, operator-ux, web-app, fact-sheet, bookmarklet, vietnamese
- Routed as: /implement (implement-feature)
- Builds on: MC-18 (`src/MediaCompany.Pilot.Web` read-from-link and paste mode, run `run-6fa26c9657d3`, commit 936d2f0)
  on MC-17 and MC-16. None is merged to `main`. The MC-19 session branch is cut from the MC-18 branch head.

## Description

### WHY

MC-18's two live reads (`CEO-D-1316`, `CEO-D-1317`) showed that a read without running the page's scripts gets only
Shopee's 203 KB page shell, with no product data, so the read stops `no-product`. The CEO's own browser shows every
fact. Paste mode works, but the CEO's words are: "làm manual rất take time" (doing it by hand takes a lot of time).

### WHAT THE OPERATOR DOES

1. One time: in "Cài đặt", the app shows a button the operator drags to the browser's bookmark bar (a bookmarklet),
   with short Vietnamese instructions.
2. For each product: the operator opens that product's page on shopee.vn in their own browser, as today, and presses
   the button once.
3. The button reads what the page already shows:
   - product name;
   - classification (the selected variant, if any);
   - shop name and whether it is Mall;
   - the CHI TIẾT SẢN PHẨM specification rows;
   - price and description, for reference only;
   - the addresses of that product's own images;
   - the page address.
4. The data reaches step 1 of the local web app for the open video, and fills the same fields and candidate rows that
   MC-18's read and paste fill. The marks show the new source. The operator confirms each field and row, and picks up
   to 3 images. The app fetches those image files from the approved image hosts.
5. The MC-16 fact-sheet check and the MC-18 confirmation rule decide the save, unchanged.

### WHAT THE COMPANY ALREADY HOLDS: REUSE IT

- MC-18's fill record, marks, confirmation rule, candidate rows, image pick and image-host rule, the read switch and
  the "Cài đặt" view, and the paste parser.
- MC-17's request guard (exact Origin, per-start token), which every new route must pass.
- The headless browser the web tests already drive, used to test the button against a fixture page.

### HARD CONSTRAINTS (from `CEO-D-1313` and `CEO-D-1318`, unchanged)

1. One product per press. The button reads only the page it is pressed on. No crawling, no other pages, no batch runs,
   no scheduled reads.
2. No tool signs in. The app never sends or stores Shopee cookies, and affiliate.shopee.vn is never opened. The button
   takes no action on the operator's account.
3. No CAPTCHA solving, no forged headers, signatures or user agent, no IP rotation, no proxy. The app sends no request
   to shopee.vn pages for this feature. The only egress is image files of that product, from shopee.vn or
   `*.susercontent.com`, under the MC-18 rules (one request per image, no redirect followed, PNG or JPEG signature).
4. The web app keeps listening on 127.0.0.1 only. The MC-16 toolchain (`src/MediaCompany.Pilot`) stays unchanged with
   zero sockets.
5. Anything the button hands over is untrusted input. It is size-bounded, parsed as data, never executed, and shown
   only as text.
6. The read switch stays the one off switch: when it is off, the button's hand-over is refused and paste mode works.
7. Download no package (no npm, NuGet, pip, CDN) unless the CEO approves it by name. No generative model, no speech
   recognition.
8. Agents never sign in, create accounts, contact sellers, buy or publish, and never open shopee.vn. Frozen MC-13 and
   MC-14 and the `mediacompany` database are not touched.
9. Tests run offline against code-generated fixture pages served on 127.0.0.1. No media file is added to the
   repository.

### OPEN FOR THE SCOPE GATE (`CEO-D-1318` item 3)

- **Signed-in page.** Whether the button may be pressed on a page where the operator is signed in to Shopee. It reads
  only what is shown and sends nothing to Shopee.
- **Hand-over path.** Straight from the shopee.vn page to 127.0.0.1, which browsers may block for a public page calling
  a local address, or through the clipboard: the button copies a structured block and the operator pastes it once.
  The design phase measures which works in the installed browser against the fixture.
- **Live check.** No agent opens shopee.vn. The CEO tries the button once on a real product page in their own browser,
  after quality review.
- **Screenshots.** Each fact row still needs a screenshot file (`CEO-D-1314` item 4). The button cannot take one.

### DONE MEANS

- MC-19 runs through every phase and gate of `implement-feature`. The CEO decides at the Scope and Design gates.
- The button is shown working in the Browser pane against a fixture product page, ending in filled, confirmable fields
  at step 1, and with the switch off ending in a refusal.
- Committed and pushed on the MC-19 session branch, and the CEO gets the compare link.

### FRAMEWORK DEFECTS TO BRIEF EVERY SUBAGENT ON

All are in `research/framework-defects.md`:

- Every agent gets its own staging folder.
- A non-implementing role writes no repository file.
- An agent that claims a finding covers "every" case lists the cases.
- Gate rationales do not reach agents, so pass the CEO's decisions along (Finding 7).
- A `failure-envelope.json` of class `gate-approval-required` is stale once that phase's dispatch prompt exists
  (Finding 11).

## Acceptance criteria

_To be defined by the scope phase and approved at the Scope Gate._

# Business intent for MC-19 (the owner's request and decisions, verbatim)

## The CEO's request, 2026-10-30, in chat (MC-18 session)

After the two live reads stopped `no-product`, the CEO sent a screenshot of the same product page open in their own
browser, with every fact visible, and wrote:

"đúng là mở trình duyệt thì có đầy đủ thông. hãy tìm cách vì làm manual rất take time"

(It is true that the browser shows all the information. Find a way, because doing it by hand takes a lot of time.)

The orchestrator laid out three ways:

1. Calling Shopee's internal API. Excluded: it needs forged anti-bot signatures.
2. Running a hidden browser in the app. Not recommended: it takes Shopee cookies and runs into CAPTCHA or sign-in walls.
3. A one-click button (bookmarklet) in the operator's own browser that hands what the page shows to the app.
   Recommended.

The orchestrator asked "Mở MC-19 làm nút một chạm trên trình duyệt không?" (open MC-19 to build the one-click browser
button?). The CEO answered:

"Mở MC-19"

## Decisions in force

- `CEO-D-1318` (this request): the one-click button, bounded as recorded, with the open points left for the Scope Gate.
- `CEO-D-1313`: no sign-in, no cookies, no CAPTCHA solving, no forged headers, signatures or user agent, no IP
  rotation, no proxy. One product per click. Paste mode stays. One off switch. The CEO reviews each fact and approves
  each video (`D-002`). The terms risk stays with the CEO (`D-018`), with the same-day stop condition.
- `CEO-D-1314`: read price and description are shown for reference only, and each fact row keeps its screenshot.
- `CEO-D-1315`: image hosts are shopee.vn and `*.susercontent.com`, for that product's image files only. The switch
  is off by default and set in "Cài đặt". The user agent is honest.
- `CEO-D-1316` and `CEO-D-1317`: on real pages an honest read yields `no-product`. This is why MC-19 exists.

### 5.3 Selected Approach

- Selected: O-001 (hand-over entry, D-001), the structural choice the other seven families sit inside; their selections are the rows the table in 5.2 marks selected.
- Structural change:
  - Setup, once. "Cài đặt" (M-006) shows a draggable button. The new button route (M-004) builds it: M-002 reads the repository-held script and embeds the format version, the button mark and the page-host list.
  - The press. On a shopee.vn product page, the script reads the visible anchors (D-003), builds one block (D-002), copies it (D-007) and shows a Vietnamese notice. It sends nothing and touches no control.
  - The paste. At step 1 of the open video, the page sees the marker in a paste and posts the text to the guarded paste route (M-004). The route checks, in order:
    1. the switch (M-009)
    2. the open video
    3. the size
    4. parse, version and mark, and bounds (M-001)
    5. the page-address rule

    It then replaces the video's fill record with a button-source record (M-003) and fetches the carried images through the MC-18 image phase (M-005).
  - After the paste, the operator confirms each field and row, picks images and names one screenshot on every button-filled row in one action (D-008). The unchanged check decides the save.
  - Text without the marker takes the MC-18 paste path unchanged.
  - No toolchain file and no guard rule changes.
- Rationale:
  - The selected entry keeps one guarded door, so the switch refusal for the block sits in one place. A marked block pasted into the MC-18 paste box cannot slip past the switch.
  - The strict typed format (D-002) is the only readable format that can refuse a wrong-typed field.
  - Text anchors (D-003) trace to what the CEO's screenshot shows (F-024).
  - The internal seam allowance (D-004) is the only seam allowed by C-024, C-026 and C-033.
  - Fetching at paste (D-005) reuses the MC-18 picker with thumbnails unchanged.
  - The button mark (D-006) retires old buttons automatically.
  - The clipboard chain (D-007) keeps the second action a paste in most cases.
- Highest-scoring rejected alternative and why it lost: O-002 ties O-001 on every hard constraint and on impact surface (1 against 1), and loses at reuse leverage (3 against 4). It also leaves the paste route needing the same marker refusal, which makes two refusal points for one rule.
- Tradeoffs accepted:
  - The paste route's contract grows: a second path and new refusal codes. The MC-18 text path is kept byte-for-byte in behaviour (R-021).
  - Under D-005, up to 20 image requests per paste go to allowed image hosts, against 3 for fetching only the picked images. The CEO decides at the Design Gate (Q-001).
  - The button's host check and the app's page-address rule are duplicated on purpose (defence in depth). The fixture allowance reaches both only through the internal seam (D-004).
  - Chrome's behaviour on a real page (A-002, A-003, A-009) is not measured in this phase. It is measured on the fixture at P-002 and P-004, and the CEO's try (SC-42) is the first real evidence (Q-005).

  - Current shape: MC-18 paste route (F-004).

  - Coexistence period: none beyond the build.
  - Retirement condition: not applicable; nothing is retired.

## Operational Considerations

- Logging and observability (M-004, M-005):
  - Every image request of a block fill is a read-log line (F-012).
  - The route log records the paste route as for every route.
  - The block text is never logged: only its size, its outcome code and its count of addresses and rows.
- Error handling strategy (S12):
  - Every D-010 refusal is an expected outcome: a Vietnamese reason, next step and bracketed code, with nothing filled (C-019).
  - The image phase keeps MC-18 behaviour: no retry; the first image-phase stop keeps the filled facts and names the remaining images (F-011).
  - A button-side failure (not a product page, not shopee.vn, clipboard refused) is shown in the button's own notice and copies nothing or falls back (D-007, D-011).
- Security considerations (S09):
  - The block is untrusted, even from the operator's own press (R-014):
    - its size is checked before parsing; the parse is strict and depth-limited (C-014, D-014)
    - its text is shown only as text (F-025, C-015)
    - every filled value needs confirmation (C-007)
  - The guard and content policy are unchanged; the shopee.vn page never calls 127.0.0.1 (C-016, M-007).
  - The button reads no cookie, storage interface or account area (D-003, A-014). A signed-in page hands over normally (C-012).
  - Image egress happens only for carried addresses under the MC-18 rule, and never for the page's own path (C-010, D-016). One residual is recorded: a crafted block could name another shopee.vn path as an image (R-017).
  - The seam is internal and is never passed by the shipped entry point. A shipped-executable case shows a 127.0.0.1 page address refused (C-026, D-004, R-016).
  - The clipboard holds only public page facts (R-015).
  - Compliance: the CEO carries the terms risk. The switch is the stop condition (C-017). No agent opens a Shopee host (C-023).
- Performance considerations (S08):
  - Bounded by C-014 through D-014.
  - The button walks only the product region and the two anchored sections.
  - The image phase keeps the F-012 bounds and runs one at a time app-wide (F-005).
- Deployment or operability impact:
  - The same single web executable.
  - The operator drags the button once from "Cài đặt", and again after any button change (D-006, R-022).
  - The switch stays off until the operator turns it on (F-008).
  - No database, service or browser extension (D-013, X-011). The S06 database area changes nothing.
